text:
Iris (PM): Quick callout 10m: need a compact launch blurb for Private Deploy that sales can paste. Focus: packaging presets, upgrade lanes, and customer-network obligations. Any must-haves?
Ben (Eng): Keep it simple: three presets (lite, standard, enterprise). Call out that "pinned" builds add storage and KV-shard pinning overhead.
Olivia (Infra): Ops caveat: pinned-version customers require KV-shard migration planning and may see longer RTO. Also require an "egress reservation form" from the customer for IP guarantees.
Diego (Sales): Field asks: finance and retail customers ask for guaranteed blackout slots around month-end. Offer monthly reserved slot + pay-per-event voucher.
Harper (Solutions): Suggest a small operational token: "no-upgrade voucher" (monthly) vs ad-hoc hold (higher fee). Make prerequisites explicit: customer-provided IP block + named network owner.
Sam (Legal): Contract language draft: "Blackout windows and egress IP reservation are enforceable only for Enterprise tier when listed in the SOW. Other tiers are accommodated on a best-effort basis."
Iris (PM): Works. Let's give Sales two paste-ready lines per preset and a tiny YAML example. Ben, can you do YAML + perf expectations?
Ben (Eng): Quick YAML snippet for docs:
```yaml
preset: lite
telemetry: minimal
upgrade: automated_rolling
egress: best_effort
blackout: none
```
```yaml
preset: standard
telemetry: opt_out
upgrade: scheduled_with_customer
egress: reserved_on_request
blackout: monthly_slot
```
```yaml
preset: enterprise
telemetry: off_by_default
upgrade: pinned_or_scheduled
egress: contract_reserved
blackout: contractual
```
Ben (Eng): Perf targets (rough): lite 99.5%, standard 99.8%, enterprise negotiable to 99.95 depending on pinned tradeoffs.
Olivia (Infra): Add ops footnote to doc: "Pinned builds increase storage by ~X% and can add 30-90m to rollback time depending on KV size." (we'll replace X with measured numbers later).
Diego (Sales): I'll craft two one-liners per preset and sample pricing bands then ping back.
Harper (Solutions): I'll collect two pilot quotes about blackout pricing and drop them here.
task-bot: Created task PRIV-1204: 'Private Deploy paste-ready launch blurb + presets' assigned to Iris.
Iris (PM): Action items: Ben -> paste-ready YAML + perf numbers (Tue). Olivia -> ops footnote + KV migration note (Mon). Sam -> SOW clause + one-sentence legal lines (Wed). Diego -> sales one-liners + price bands (Thu). Harper -> pilot quotes (Thu). I'll collate and publish a one-pager after inputs. End thread.
